label: Demo project data: the brief is the project owner's own words; nothing here is model output.
name: Under the Flyover
brief: While travelling in Hyderabad, I saw a homeless child squatting beneath a flyover, wearing dirty, torn clothes and deeply absorbed in scrolling reels on a smartphone. The contrast disturbed me. I want to explore that moment through a short, realistic film. The location is beneath a flyover at a U-turn, on a raised planting bed containing soil, with a few bags, covers and basic cooking utensils, not a tent. Use a fictional child. Distinguish the observed moment from creative additions; do not invent a backstory or assert that scrolling caused his poverty.

direction.palette: natural daylight; concrete greys and dust
direction.notes: no music; no on-screen text or logos

decisions: The child is fictional and must not resemble any identifiable real child.
Keep the observed moment separate from creative additions; no invented backstory.
Do not suggest that scrolling, or the phone, caused his poverty.
Location: beneath a flyover at a U-turn, on a raised planting bed of soil with a few bags, covers and basic cooking utensils; not a tent.
